messages:
alex: quick heads-up 1  noticed production returns 403 for the diagram in docs/connectors/aws.md. Also the file has no `maintainer` in frontmatter. Can someone pick this up? /cc @jamie
doc-bot: [alert] asset-check failed: /docs/connectors/aws#diagram (403)  scanned 2025-09-01T07:02:10Z
jamie: I can take it. Which exact path and do we want a redirect?
alex: File: docs/connectors/aws.md. Problem image: https://cdn-old.example.com/diagrams/aws-connector.svg -> replace with our CDN version. If the old link is public (it might be in a partner guide), add a redirects.yaml entry too. Short-term: swap to relative asset and add frontmatter `maintainer: jamie`. Long-term: add owner to OWNERS.yaml for connectors/.
jamie: Plan: 1) replace absolute URL with `assets/diagrams/aws-connector.svg` (no leading slash) 2) add frontmatter `maintainer: jamie` 3) add OWNERS entry `connectors/: - jamie` 4) add changelog line 5) run local smoke (mkdocs + link checker) 6) open PR and request quick review. ETA ~25m.
lena: One accessibility nit: please include alt text `alt=\"AWS connector flow diagram\"` and a short caption line under the image: \"Diagram rehosted to CDN (2025-09-01)\" so search history surfaces the reason.
jamie: Good call. Local commands I'll run: ```bash
git checkout -b docs/rehost-aws-diagram-318999
# edit file
mkdocs build && tools/link-checker --site-dir site
# run local preview
mkdocs serve --dev-addr=127.0.0.1:8000
```
jamie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123  title: \"docs: rehost AWS connector diagram + add maintainer\"  labels: docs, smallfix
deploy-bot: Deploy preview ready  https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/9123  link-checker: passed  image served 200
lena: Quick review: looks good. Two tiny nits: a) use relative path to assets without query params, b) add the redirects.yaml entry if we confirm external references. I can grep the repo and confirm.
jamie: Updated PR: used `assets/diagrams/aws-connector.svg` (no query params), added frontmatter `maintainer: jamie`, added OWNERS entry, and added a redirects.yaml suggestion in the PR description (waiting on grep result).
alex: I grepped partner docs; one external guide uses the old absolute URL. Please add redirect entry: `/cdn-old.example.com/diagrams/aws-connector.svg -> /assets/diagrams/aws-connector.svg`. That will be a small redirects patch.
jamie: Added redirects.yaml change to the branch and updated changelog: \"2025-09-01  connectors/aws: rehost diagram + maintainer + redirect  jamie\". Rebuilt locally, preview shows image and caption.
lena: LGTM from accessibility side. I'll add a quick review comment and approve.
jamie: Thanks! Merging after CI green. Alex, do you want me to add a sprint card to rotate connectors owners quarterly?
\alex: Yes please, add a card under docs board and tag docs-rotations. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
